name: print-social-orange-marketing-services-post-with-3d-like-bubbles
title: Orange 'We Provide Marketing Services' post with script accent, 3D like bubbles and swirl texture
whatItIs: A square orange-to-yellow post with a swirling ripple texture, a red script 'we' over rounded white 'Provide Marketing Services', a smiling man in a beanie and pink jacket, glossy 3D heart and like bubbles, dashed curved arrows and a giant faded vertical word on the right.
whatItMeans: Warm, youthful and social; glossy reactions make it feel like engagement is guaranteed.
techniques: Add a subtle ripple texture to a gradient.
Float 3D reaction icons around the subject.
Run a giant ghost word vertically as backdrop.
Use dashed arrows for a playful path.

vocabulary.definition: Oversized, low-contrast text used as background.
A like, heart or emoji symbol.
